title: Rejoining Oliver's band and the 1923 records; Bertha's timeline
summary: She rejoined Oliver so she and Louis were in the same band, which made the spring 1923 records; further discussion of when Bertha was in the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: I was playing there, but he was playing with Joe at the Gardens.

I wasn't with him. That's right. Then Joe asked me to join the band again and this girl went back. So, I joined the band. Then that made Louie and all of us the same band. And it was after I joined the band again and Louie was there that we made the records which was 23.
That's straight. That's all straight. All right. Now,
